---
title: "Annotations on blocks with a derived name"
filters:
  - code-window
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
extensions:
  code-window:
    style: macos
---

The block below is named after its language.

```{.python}
x = 1 # <1>
```

1. A value.

The block below names its own label.

```{.bash code-window-auto-label="Terminal"}
echo labelled
```

The first block below sets its own style, and the second block does not.

```{.python code-window-style="windows"}
styled = True
```

```{.python}
plain = True
```

The block below highlights one line.

```{.python code-line-numbers="2"}
first = 1
second = 2
```

::: {.callout-note}

## A callout

```{.python}
a = 1 # <1>
```

1. A value in a callout.

:::

The div below has the shape an engine gives an executed cell.

::: {.cell}

```{.python .cell-code}
b = 1 # <1>
```

:::

1. A value in a cell.
